title: Aoyagi Toya — Your Stomach Doesn't Lie〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Okay. We know when and where we'll be performing, as well as who's going to be participating.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (There seems to be no problems with our ticket prices, so I should let Azusawa know that she can include that on our flyer now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That just leaves doing an equipment check. Ultramarine should be able to supply us with most of what we need...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I won't know for sure until I see what each team's set list entails...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I already have the one for EVER, so that just leaves Mita and Tono...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If we do plan on changing anything, it should be our song choices or how we bridge between them. For example, what if I switched out my song...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right now?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. It didn't go very well with Mita's song, so that may've hurt our vibe a little.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Mita's good at being an MC, so he should interact with the audience as much as possible at the end of his song. I'll try to sing something that goes with that flow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tono in particular was still adjusting his set list during practice, so he may still be considering other songs.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I should probably contact him to see what's going on.)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for pushing back when practice starts because of my own business.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't worry, dude. Anyway, did you manage to take care of that event stuff you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, one thing's been settled.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, just one...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, I have all the information you'll need for the flyer. I've sent it over to your phone, so I hope you get a chance to look at it later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what else do you have left to do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, a list of equipment that we'll need for the day of the event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I had to stop what I was doing to contact Mita and Tono about their set lists since I've yet to see them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? They haven't sent in their set lists yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, didn't you set a deadline?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's tomorrow. They still have time, so we should be okay after I check up on them again today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... I'll remind Mita and Tono to give us their set lists if I happen to see them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that would also help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, Toya, leaving all the clerical stuff to you was definitely the right call.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you've been a really big help. Despite it being your first time, you seem to know exactly what to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have the staff at Ultramarine to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They've been nice enough to show me how this process works and what to look out for beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's always important to check with someone about that sort of stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Take me and my dad for example. He'll say, “Go get some stuff,” and I'll reply, “Okay,” but totally forget to ask what to buy before leaving.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That just means you're a knucklehead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You usually have everything under control, An, so it's kind of cute seeing this side of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Koohaaaneee!
You're the only person who'd ever say something so nice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! Oh, An...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anything else that's giving you trouble, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sure? We get that you're the one that's best suited for this job, but you don't actually have to do everything all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, if you say so.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, there they are!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, it's you...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why are you leering at us like that? Did we do something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, is this about our set lists?
Aoyagi already let us know about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Cough them up already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. What a bad boy.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: O-Okay, I get it! I still had to make some adjustments after practice the other day!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But here you go. My set list.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And this is mine.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I apologize for cutting it a little close. However, I believe you'll be satisfied with it. I appreciate the extra time you gave me, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, thank you as well.
I'll look over it later.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hehe. This should keep your partner from biting our heads off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tsk...
Anyway, let's start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait you guys are about to practice?
Mind if I join?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you still mad?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, that should be enough.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
Jump in if you want.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tono, would you also like to join us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We should sing together since we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, I think I'll just have to take you up on that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.
